title: Interactive 3D Gallery Viewer
description: A modular, touchscreen-friendly system for interacting with 3D artworks in gallery settings. Users can rotate a sculpture, drag accessories onto it, and explore multiple configurations — all running locally in a browser using Three.js. The system features snap-to-socket attachment, stackable accessories, a scrollable tray, visual socket markers, sound feedback, and a config-driven architecture that requires no code changes to swap artworks or accessories.
